title: A miss names heuristic vs classifier vs graph mapping
description:
As an engineer, I want a miss to say whether the YAML rule failed, the classifier dropped it, or the graph mapper dropped it, so that one blended score does not hide the layer.

Feature: miss attribution

  Scenario: Heuristic miss
    Given gold for a Stripe import
    And matchPatterns emits no stripe hit
    When I score the case
    Then the miss is attributed to heuristic

  Scenario: Classifier miss
    Given a raw stripe hit
    And no third_party component is produced
    When I score the case
    Then the miss is attributed to classifier

  Scenario: Graph mapping miss
    Given a third_party Stripe component in the scan result
    And dataflow.json has no Stripe node
    When I score the case
    Then the miss is attributed to graph mapping
